inputs.description: Name for the EF Core migration (PascalCase, e.g. AddWorkflowTable)

tasks.label: verify:restore
tasks.detail: Restore all NuGet packages for the solution. Run after pulling changes or editing .csproj/.props files. No external dependencies.

tasks.label: verify:build
tasks.detail: Build the entire solution (all projects). Runs an implicit restore. Use to validate that all code compiles cleanly. Output is suppressed unless errors occur.

tasks.label: verify:build-server
tasks.detail: Build only the Werkr.Server (Blazor UI) project and its dependencies. Useful when iterating on UI changes without rebuilding the entire solution.

tasks.label: verify:format
tasks.detail: Auto-format all C# code in the solution using dotnet format (.editorconfig rules). Run before committing. No external dependencies.

tasks.label: verify:start-apphost
tasks.detail: Launch all Werkr components locally via .NET Aspire (Server, API, Agent). Opens the Aspire dashboard. Use for manual integration testing. Stop with Ctrl+C.

tasks.label: verify:docker-check
tasks.detail: Validate docker-compose.yml syntax without starting containers. Requires Docker to be running.

tasks.label: verify:docker-build
tasks.detail: Generate TLS certs and build all Docker images (Server, API, Agent). Requires Docker. Run before docker:start if images are stale.

tasks.label: docker:start
tasks.detail: Start all Werkr containers in detached mode (Server :5050, API :5001, Agent :5100). Requires Docker and pre-built images (run verify:docker-build first).

tasks.label: docker:stop
tasks.detail: Stop and remove all Werkr containers. Does not remove volumes or images.

tasks.label: docker:restart
tasks.detail: Stop then start all Werkr containers (sequential: docker:stop → docker:start).

tasks.label: test:dotnet
tasks.detail: Run all .NET tests at the solution level (single build, all 4 test projects together). Default verbosity: normal. Change --verbosity to 'quiet' for counts only or 'detailed' for full diagnostics. Requires Docker for Testcontainers (test:api tests).

tasks.label: test:graphui
tasks.detail: Run graph-ui TypeScript tests via Vitest. Requires Node 22+. Install deps first: npm install --prefix src/Werkr.Server/graph-ui

tasks.label: test:all
tasks.detail: Run ALL tests: .NET (solution-level) then JS/TS (Vitest). This is the default test task. Chains test:dotnet → test:graphui sequentially. Requires Docker (for Testcontainers) and Node 22+ (for Vitest).

tasks.label: test:unit
tasks.detail: Run data layer unit tests only (Werkr.Tests.Data). Fast, in-memory EF Core — no Docker needed. Change --verbosity to 'quiet' for counts only or 'detailed' for full diagnostics.

tasks.label: test:api
tasks.detail: Run API integration tests only (Werkr.Tests). Uses Testcontainers (PostgreSQL 17) + WebApplicationFactory. Requires Docker. Change --verbosity to 'quiet' for counts only or 'detailed' for full diagnostics.

tasks.label: test:server
tasks.detail: Run Blazor component tests only (Werkr.Tests.Server). Uses bunit + in-memory EF Core — no Docker needed. Change --verbosity to 'quiet' for counts only or 'detailed' for full diagnostics.

tasks.label: test:e2e
tasks.detail: Run Agent end-to-end tests only (Werkr.Tests.Agent). Tests embedded PowerShell execution, scheduling, and triggers. No Docker needed. Change --verbosity to 'quiet' for counts only or 'detailed' for full diagnostics.

tasks.label: migrate:app:postgres
tasks.detail: Add a PostgreSQL migration for the app data context (PostgresWerkrDbContext). Prompts for migration name. Output: src/Werkr.Data/Migrations/Postgres/

tasks.label: migrate:app:sqlite
tasks.detail: Add a SQLite migration for the app data context (SqliteWerkrDbContext). Prompts for migration name. Output: src/Werkr.Data/Migrations/Sqlite/

tasks.label: migrate:app
tasks.detail: Add migrations for the app data context on BOTH providers (PostgreSQL + SQLite). Prompts for migration name once, applies to both. Runs migrate:app:postgres → migrate:app:sqlite.

tasks.label: migrate:identity:postgres
tasks.detail: Add a PostgreSQL migration for the Identity context (PostgresWerkrIdentityDbContext). Prompts for migration name. Output: src/Werkr.Data.Identity/Migrations/Postgres/

tasks.label: migrate:identity:sqlite
tasks.detail: Add a SQLite migration for the Identity context (SqliteWerkrIdentityDbContext). Prompts for migration name. Output: src/Werkr.Data.Identity/Migrations/Sqlite/

tasks.label: migrate:identity
tasks.detail: Add migrations for the Identity context on BOTH providers (PostgreSQL + SQLite). Prompts for migration name once. Runs migrate:identity:postgres → migrate:identity:sqlite.

tasks.label: migrate:all
tasks.detail: Add migrations for ALL contexts and ALL providers (app + identity × postgres + sqlite). Prompts for migration name once. Runs migrate:app → migrate:identity.
